description:
About this space
Three Anchor Heart is nestled in the heart of Cape Town, offering a central location:
- V&A Waterfront – 2.3 km
- Signal Hill – 1.7 km
- Table Mountain Aerial Cableway – 6.2 km
- Cape Town Stadium – 1.2 km
- Sea Point Promenade – 500 m
- Bo-Kaap– 2.4 km
- Oceans Aquarium – 2.2 km
- Company’s Garden & South African Museum – 3.3 km
- Clifton Beaches – 4.4 km
- Camps Bay Beach – 6.5 km
- Robben Island Ferry (from Wate rfront) – 2.3 km
- Zeitz MOCAA – 2.7 km
- District Six Museum – 4.2 km

The space
This stylish studio blends comfort and functionality in a clean, contemporary design. There are 8 micro apartments in this newly renovated building.

The space features:
A queen bed neatly dressed in crisp white linen with a soft throw, creating a cozy and inviting sleeping area.

Ground apartments display modern tiles and suspended bulkhead ceilings.

An L-shaped kitchenette in the corner is compact yet well-appointed, including:

- A fridge and microwave
- Sleek cabinetry with ample storage
- A sink and under-counter lighting
- Basic appliances such as a 2 plate Smeg stove and kettle.
Essential cookware included, perfect for preparing simple meals or snacks.

A built-in desk/workspace by the large window provides natural light and is ideal for remote work or casual use.

Generous wardrobe space with modern black handles, offering both closed storage and open shelving for display or practical use.

Wooden features throughout add warmth and elegance, complementing the soft neutral palette of the room.

Guest access
Your room's front door has a Smart Access Yale lock, which uses biometrics, pin codes and digital tags.

You'll receive a code before you arrive to enter the building, and a second unique code for your room. The room code changes with each guest visit.
